nodes.brief:
Maps and atlases are spatial representations showing geography, political boundaries, infrastructure networks, or thematic data distribution. They encode complex geographic relationships into visual form, letting a reader grasp scale, distance, and adjacency at a glance that prose description cannot convey as efficiently.

Within [[09]] Reference & Documentation, this branch is the reference counterpart to the applied skill covered in [[08.06]] Navigation: a map is the artifact, navigation is the practice of reading and correlating it against real terrain. It also relates to [[09.10]] Historical Archives, since historical maps are themselves primary sources documenting how borders, settlements, and place names changed over time, and to [[01]] Natural Sciences, since thematic maps of climate, geology, or ecosystems apply earth-science data to cartographic form.

For a comprehensive open cartographic dataset, see [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/), and for authoritative historical map collections, the [David Rumsey Map Collection](https://www.davidrumsey.com/).

nodes.name: Topographic Maps
nodes.en: Representation of terrain by contour, relief and feature symbology, and reading elevation and slope from a sheet.
nodes.cs: Znázornění terénu vrstevnicemi, stínováním a smluvenými značkami a čtení nadmořské výšky a sklonu z mapového listu.

nodes.name: Thematic and Statistical Maps
nodes.en: Maps carrying a single variable over geography, the classification choices they require, and how those choices change the message.
nodes.cs: Mapy nesoucí jednu proměnnou nad územím, klasifikační volby, jež vyžadují, a jak tyto volby mění sdělení.

nodes.name: Nautical and Aeronautical Charts
nodes.en: Navigation-specific representations: depth, hazard, airspace and procedure, and the currency requirements attached to them.
nodes.cs: Navigačně specifická zobrazení: hloubka, překážka, vzdušný prostor a postupy a požadavky na jejich aktuálnost.

nodes.name: Atlases and Gazetteers
nodes.en: Bound and indexed collections, place-name authority, and the political sensitivity of naming and boundary depiction.
nodes.cs: Vázané a rejstříkované sbírky, autorita zeměpisných jmen a politická citlivost pojmenování a zákresu hranic.
